title: Personalize Your Recipe Collections With Full Color Icons
summary: The official blog of the AnyList team.
body_markdown:
The latest update to AnyList includes hundreds of full color icons for personalizing your recipe collections.


The same icons can also be used with your recipes — useful if you don’t have a photo for a particular recipe.


You can update to the latest version of AnyList from the[App Store](https://geo.itunes.apple.com/us/app/anylist-grocery-shopping-list/id522167641?mt=8&at=1000lmUx) or[Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.purplecover.anylist) .


We hope you enjoy this update, and if you have any questions or feedback, please[let us know](https://www.anylist.com/contact) .
